_spec.purpose: Every critic verdict, every run, so the machine can see its own repetition. A defect in REPEAT_AT or more distinct runs is escalated from a script problem to a PROCESS problem, and retro.py names the phase that owns it.
_spec.why: The funny critic failed two consecutive episodes for the same reason and nothing counted, so each run re-learned it and moved on. Cross-run memory is the difference between a machine that improves and one that merely repeats.

entries.note: Genuinely funny in two specific places and inert in between. It buries its own best joke behind a spreadsheet.
Hook's payload is in the back half of the sentence; runtime not earned.
The central absurdity is a duplicate row in a database, the most boring failure a computer can have.
A fifteen-year-old internet aphorism with a swear stapled on.
The promised angle never becomes a line.
The two funniest lines are the same joke about the same fact, twenty-eight seconds apart.
The last fifteen seconds are the ending the viewer already had loaded at second forty.
Duplicate rows in a database is infuriating but not absurd, so the writing has to carry a premise it was never built to carry.
